inputs.text: According to Bloomberg, as energy prices rise, flights are canceled, and death and destruction fill screens every day, people across the world are asking when the Iran war — which is widely viewed as poorly planned, unwinnable, and a peril to global well-being — will stop. The report notes, "Not in Israel, where the public is strongly behind seeing the war through until [...]
